title: Safe Price Lookup
description: A tiny shop price table holds apple at 5 and banana at 3. Read one query word and print its price, or 0 when the word is not in the table. This is a targeted remedial probe for C6-M01 (missing-key-handling): indexing the table with an absent key raises KeyError instead of answering 0, so the unknown-item cases distinguish guarded-lookup reasoning from direct-index reasoning. Like every EvidencePack, a failure here is observed evidence that can help diagnosis, never a deterministic detection on its own.
constraints: The query is a single word of 1 to 50 characters.
input_format: A single word (the item to look up).
output_format: A single integer: the price, or 0 when the item is not stocked.
